notes.title: Winter Update + Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
We have prepared an update for you to celebrate the upcoming Christmas and New Year!
The update added a final location, in which the Russians can celebrate their victory over the lizards on their home planet - Nibiru!
In addition, we added auto damage, slightly rebalanced the locations so that you are less stuck on the final ones, and also fixed some bugs and made general improvements!

In addition, our game is participating in the Steam winter sale, so you can buy it with a 40% discount until January 4, 2024! Thank you for your activity and support!

Marry Christmas and happy New Year!
